itens.titulo: Micron stock dips after earnings despite answer to analyst's key question
itens.descricao: Micron stock dips after earnings despite answer to analyst's key question Yahoo Finance
trechos: Going into Micron's (MU) Q4 earnings on Wednesday, analysts weren't too concerned about demand for the company's memory and storage.
After all, data center builders are buying up chips so fast that Micron and rivals SK Hynix (SKHY) and Samsung (005930.KS) can't keep up.
During the company's earnings call, Micron CFO Mark Murphy explained that he anticipates Q1 gross margins will set a new floor and that they'll climb higher from there.
Micron stock fell 2% in morning trading on Thursday.
According to Murphy, Micron's Q1 margins will take a ding due to increased fiscal 2026 financial compensation related to manufacturing.
The company absorbed most of that increase in Q4, but the impact will be felt in Q1.
As a result, he told analysts, Micron anticipates gross margins will climb beyond Q1 on the back of more moderate price increases.
Micron stock is up around 280% this year as of Tuesday's close.

itens.titulo: Petrobras eleva preço do querosene de aviação em outubro
itens.descricao: Petrobras eleva preço do querosene de aviação em outubro InfoMoney
trechos: Publicidade RIO DE JANEIRO, 1 Out (Reuters) – A Petrobras aumentou o preço de venda de querosene de aviação (QAV) para as distribuidoras a partir desta quinta-feira, conforme dados divulgados pela companhia para as principais bases de distribuição do país.

Dentre os principais pontos de venda, a alta do combustível em Guarulhos (SP) foi de 11,6%, conforme cálculo realizado com base na tabela de preços divulgada pela companhia, enquanto em Duque de Caxias (RJ) foi de 12% e em Betim (MG), 11,6%.
O aumento de outubro ocorre após uma elevação média de cerca de 13,9% em setembro em relação ao mês anterior.

itens.titulo: With record earnings in the rearview, Micron faces Taiwan strike prospects
itens.descricao: With record earnings in the rearview, Micron faces Taiwan strike prospects Yahoo Finance Singapore
trechos: Fourth-quarter revenue came in at $54.23 billion, ahead of the $50.45 billion consensus and nearly five times the $11.32 billion reported a year earlier.
Adjusted earnings of $33.42 a share beat estimates of $31.16.
For the full fiscal year, revenue reached $133.19 billion against $37.38 billion the prior year, with operating margin at 76% on a non-GAAP basis.
Guidance was also strong, with Micron expecting first-quarter revenue of $60 billion to $63 billion, well above the $56.77 billion consensus, and earnings of $37.15 to $39.15 a share.

"Micron delivered record fiscal 2026 results, and we expect an even stronger fiscal 2027," said Chairman and CEO Sanjay Mehrotra, pointing to demand from AI and the company's Strategic Customer Agreements.

According to reports, Micron said its roughly 15,000 Taiwan employees would receive the company's largest-ever compensation package for fiscal 2026, worth the equivalent of 35 to 68 months of base salary for production staff.
Even so, the Taoyuan union is pushing for a permanent mechanism allocating 15% of operating profit to employee bonuses, rather than another one-off payout.
21, and the union has announced plans for a strike vote.

itens.titulo: Micron CEO Says ‘We Cannot Fulfill The Demand’ As Supply Tightness Extends Through 2028
itens.descricao: Micron CEO Says ‘We Cannot Fulfill The Demand’ As Supply Tightness Extends Through 2028 Yahoo Finance
trechos: -       More than 75% of Micron's 2027 output is already committed, according to management's comments on the earnings call.
-       Mehrotra defended record employee incentive compensation, while pointing to an 86.35% gross-margin outlook.

Micron Technology (MU) CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said on Thursday morning that demand for memory is outpacing the company's ability to supply it, with tight market conditions expected to persist through 2028.
"Not only do we have more customers and customers wanting to do long-term supply agreements with us," Mehrotra said in an interview with CNBC after Micron's fiscal fourth-quarter (Q4) results.
"In fact, we cannot fulfill the demand of our customers." MU stock dropped more than 2.5% in the morning trade and was the top-trending ticker on Stocktwits at the time of writing.

Micron Sees Supply Tight Through 2028 Mehrotra said the company is seeing supply remain tight in both 2027 and 2028, while long-term customer commitments are extending well beyond the immediate cycle.
"We have extensions going into the 2031 time frame," he said, adding that the agreements give Micron "tremendous visibility, certainty of demand" and confidence to plan manufacturing investments.
Executives on the earnings call stated that Micron has more than 75% of its 2027 output already committed, with customer discussions increasingly focused on 2028.
